Name: SageFelix - Younger Magnus Rasmodius Portraits
Author: SageFelix
Description:
[size=6][b][u][i][quote]12 expressions, SVE and Vanilla ver. now available.[/quote][/i][/u][/b][/size][size=3]This is my very first mod. It changes Wizard's overall appearance to look younger in my style.
[i][u]
What to expect from this mod?[/u][/i]

This mod, aside from changing Magnus' portraits, also changes (almost) all his sprites, and has his seasonal outfits. I made this mod specifically for use with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7000]Romanceable Rasmodius - SVE Compatible[/url]. I will make different expression sheets to fit other mods in the future! :)
[s]
The mod requires the mod[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10971] HD Portraits[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher [/url]in order to work.[/s]
The mod now requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url] to work, there's no need to change or move portrait files, just [b]press [P] and portraits should show[/b]


[i][u]Incompatibilities 

[/u][/i]As far as I know, if you use another HD portrait mod with this mod (for example [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11904]1oxnes and talkohlooeys' Seasonal Portraits[/url]) this can find a conflict and none of those will show. I'm still looking for a solution to it, if anyone could help me find one I would apprecieate it soo much. 

[s](Sorry in advance for my spaghetti coding, I have zero clue on how to code)﻿[/s]

[u]Edit: 3/18/23[/u]

Hat version added!!

Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/171038143]Preachie[/url] for finding a way to make my mod work with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11904]1oxnes and talkohlooeys's[/url] portrait mod, please check the pinned comment!
I highly recommend using the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to easily toggle the hat! Or you can also toggle it through the file called 'config' by changing the value 'true' (hat on) to 'false' (hat off). The[i] hat is on by default[/i]!

[/size][s]What's coming next? Vanilla and 7 expressions' version! [/s] [size=3]Done!
[/size]
